title: CLMS Top-of-Canopy (TOC) Reflectance Global 300m daily V2 (NetCDF)
description: Provides top-of-canopy reflectances derived from Sentinel-3/OLCI observations at global scale in the spatial resolution of 300 m on a daily basis.

bands.description: Classification and quality flags

bands.cdse:long_description: Quality flags from OLCI Level 1B, stored as 32-bit bit mask (see PUM Table 9).

bands.name: pixel_classif_flags
bands.description: OLCI Idepix Cloud mask

cdse:browser_search_path: CLMS Bio-geophysical Parameters, Temperature and Reflectance, Surface Reflectance
cdse:collection_description: Atmospherically-corrected surface reflectances from Sentinel-3 OLCI and SLSTR sensors observations are provided. Uncertainties are associated to the reflectance values. The data are available at global scale in the spatial resolution of ~300 m and cover the period from June 2018 to the present.
